user_question: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve tract land-area table
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate CSV table containing land area values for the census tracts covering Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a candidate tract-level land-area attribute table covering Centre County. Treat the result as a candidate; runtime QC must verify spatial coverage, tract-level correspondence, required fields, and analytical suitability.

workflow_steps.title: Join population table to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach the supplied total population values to the Centre County census tract polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the supplied population table to the census tract polygons. Runtime QC must ground the vector and table join fields from the observed schemas; do not assume or invent join-key names.

workflow_steps.title: Join land area to population-enriched tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach tract-level land area values to the tract polygons already enriched with total population.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the retrieved land-area table to the population-enriched tract vector. Runtime QC must ground both join fields and the land-area field from observed schemas; do not assume or invent field names.

requirements.scope: The land_area_table candidate must provide tract-level land-area data covering Centre County.
The supplied population table must contain the observed tract identifier and total population fields needed for the attribute join.
The retrieved land_area_table must contain a tract identifier and a land-area measure suitable for reporting by census tract.
The retrieved land_area_table must be consumable by the attribute_join operation.

skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.
